fato_historico: 1899: The Second Boer War: A British column is engaged by Boer forces at the Battle of Modder River; although the Boers withdraw, the British suffer heavy casualties.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a test of your legendary resilience. Just as history teaches us that even amidst challenging skirmishes, the spirit remains unbroken, you may find your inner strength reaching new peaks. It is a good time to turn obstacles into stepping stones and let your bold, pioneering energy lead the way toward personal triumph and growth.
frase_do_dia: True power is found in the heart that keeps moving forward.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of ambition and building lasting foundations.
conselho: Consider your next steps carefully and trust your intuition to guide you home.
